fusions.name: Barbed Catch
fusions.desc: Snags the target on the barbed rim of your shield, dealing 10 damage, stunning it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Haul to the Rim
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it in toward your shield and dealing 26 damage to each. A boss or elite caught also loses 4% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Snag the Bolt
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, your shield catches elemental attacks: 30% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Caught and Covered
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
